learning_outcomes.description: Integrate financial and non-financial data from multiple sources to make robust investment decisions.
Analyse return streams on the various stages of a private business/venture evolution over different investment horizons to maximise returns on exit.
Present conclusions, key valuation strategies and findings to stakeholders with a group of peers.
Evaluate technological feasibility and business model viability.
Customise incentive frameworks appropriate for different stakeholders within the investment model.

assessments.task_description:
This assessment aims to evaluate students' ability to work in a group with a scenario and provide appropriate responses using the techniques and approaches covered in the course. On Day 3 Students will be expected to orally present findings to a panel in the face-to-face session and subsequently submit a reflection analysing the group performance including challenges encountered and alternative future decisions.

You will be assessed on the quality of the investment screening content, the quality of the group’s presentation, and Q&A, as outlined in the rubric. Further details are provided on the course Blackboard site.

The Mock IC will comprise the course coordinator and two other industry representatives.

As part of the group assessment, you will also be required to complete a peer-review following the group presentation

assessments.task_description:
This assessment aims to develop reflective and analytical skills by requiring learners to summarise workshop insights and identify key takeaways. Framing the response from a VC or Buyout perspective ensures application to real-world investment decisions, moving to critical evaluation.

Following the presentation on Day 3 of the face-to -face workshops and from the group activities during Day 1 and Day 2 of the workshop, you will submit a short reflection piece (no more than 2 pages) on the exercises done in your group, highlighting what you did well, what you could have done better and what you learnt from that exercise.
